body.message: Supply a viewerClaims object with an optional region and boolean ageConfirmed.
Your application has not confirmed age-restricted delivery for this viewer.
Supply the viewer's ISO country code, such as DE or GB.
Supply the viewer region when regional delivery controls apply.
This asset needs moderation evidence for the newly served jurisdiction.
The signed URL has expired. Create a new one on your server.
The signed asset URL's grant wasn't signed for this project, or was changed after signing. Use the URL as created, adding only resources, selectors and viewer claims.
This signed asset URL doesn't grant the original file. Sign it with original access.
The request's parameters, query or body are invalid. details.issues lists each problem, with its path and issue code.
Issue code in details.issues: a field has the wrong type.
Issue code in details.issues: a value is below its minimum.
Issue code in details.issues: a value is above its maximum.
Issue code in details.issues: a string is not in the required format, such as an ID or URL.
Issue code in details.issues: a field has a value it cannot take.
Issue code in details.issues: the request has a field this endpoint does not accept.
Send the request body as application/json.
The filter has invalid syntax or names a field that can't be filtered.
The list cannot be ordered by this field.
No endpoint matches this method and path.
An internal error occurred. Retry later, and quote requestId to support.
Authentication required.
The session token has expired. Sign in again.
The session token is invalid. Sign in again.
Search is temporarily unavailable. Retry later.
The transform names an unknown type or is not a valid selector.
The transform's options are invalid for its type.
The remote URL redirected too many times.
The cursor is invalid or belongs to a different query.
Authentication required. Send your project API key in the X-Api-Key header.
The API key is invalid, revoked or expired. Create a key under Developer → API Keys.
This API key belongs to a different project. Use a key created for the project that owns this resource.
API keys are only accepted by the public API at /v1.

This API key lacks a permission the request needs (details.permission names it, such as assets:download for an asset's folder, and details.role the least role that includes it), or the resource belongs to another project.
The file is larger than allowed. details.limitBytes is the limit, and details.source says whether it is the plan's (`plan`) or the upload preset's (`preset`).
The document holds more embedded images or audio and video files than can be moderated: details.limit is `images` or `media` and details.maximum the most allowed. Split it into smaller documents.

The audio or video is longer than allowed: details.durationSeconds is what its file states and details.limitSeconds the limit. Trim it or split it into separate uploads; before billing is set up, setting it up raises the limit.
The image is corrupt or cannot be decoded. Upload a valid image file.
The image exceeds a processing limit: details.limit is `bytes`, `pixels` or `dimension`. Reduce its size before uploading.
This project's organisation has used its free uploads. Set up billing to continue uploading.
Uploads to this project are paused by its organisation's usage limits. See details.reason; an owner can review them in Billing.

The file type is not accepted. details.source is `calmlens` when CalmLens cannot store and process it (use a concrete MIME type such as image/png, application/pdf or text/plain) or `preset` when the upload preset doesn't allow it (details.contentType and details.allowedContentTypes say what was sent and what it accepts).
Upload payload is invalid.
Send the asset's name and fields in the request body (the JSON body, or the options part of a multipart/form-data upload), not in the query string.
Use uploadPart for multipart upload parts after the first part
Asset is not accepting additional parts
Multipart upload part number is invalid.
Multipart upload state is missing
The uploaded parts do not add up to the totalSizeInBytes declared when the multipart upload started.
The Idempotency-Key header must be 1 to 255 printable ASCII characters, such as a UUID.
This Idempotency-Key was already used for a different request. Use a new key for each distinct request.
A request with this Idempotency-Key is still being processed. Retry after the Retry-After delay to receive its result.

This asset has no such resource: text and spreadsheets have no rendered version or preview, and documents, audio and video get theirs once processing makes them. Check the asset's `content.rendered` and `content.preview`, or request its original resource instead.
Asset not found
Project not found
This asset was extracted from another asset (its `parentId`), so it can't be deleted on its own. Delete the asset it was extracted from instead, which deletes it too.
The asset changed during review. Refresh and review the current decision.
A note is required when changing the decision.
Failed to update asset
The asset is held and this request can't change or deliver it. details.hold is `safety` for a safety hold or `copyright` for a copyright claim.
Wait for the asset to finish uploading and processing before deciding it.
This asset has no moderation decision yet, so it can only be blocked or purged. Allow, limit or age-restrict it once moderation has decided it.
The asset already has this moderation status.
Only assets that failed to process (status error) can be retried.
This asset's content is no longer stored, so it can't be processed again. Upload it again instead.
This asset's content was purged, so it can only be blocked. Upload it again to have it moderated afresh.
This asset has no automatic moderation decision to explain yet.
The project's moderation policy has changed since this decision, so it can't be explained as made. Re-run moderation with the current policy instead.
A reviewer has decided this asset, so its moderation can't be re-run.
Support ticket not found.
An asset with this externalId already exists in the project.
Folder not found
A folder with this name already exists in this location.
Folder must be empty before it can be deleted.
A folder cannot be moved inside itself or one of its descendants.
Lens not found. Check the lens ID or identifier in the portal.
The project already has a lens with this identifier. Update that lens, or give this one another identifier.
The identifier belongs to a built-in lens (thumbnail, sm, md, lg, xl or 2xl). Give the lens another identifier.
Hash list not found. Check the list ID in the portal.
Hash list entry not found.
This project has the most hash lists it can hold. Delete a list to add another.
This project's hash lists hold the most entries they can. Remove entries to add more.
This asset has no perceptual hash. Only image assets that finished processing can be added.
Policy not found. Check the policy ID in the portal.
The policy changed. Retrieve it again and retry with its current revision.
The projects using this policy changed. Retrieve it again and review the affected projects before saving.
Projects or upload presets still use this policy. Choose another policy for each of them before deleting it.
Another project uses this policy, so it can only be changed from the portal or that project.
This policy has no preset baseline.
The preset changed. Review the latest differences and retry with its version.
Only an unchanged copy of an older preset version can be updated. Reset or review your changes first.
Automatic updates can only be switched on for a saved copy of one of the organisation's own preset policies, and off for one that has them.
Upload preset not found. Check the preset ID in the portal.
This upload preset is paused. Turn it on in the portal to accept uploads.
This upload preset only accepts uploads with an upload token. Sign one on your server with uploadTokens.sign and pass it to the client.
This project doesn't accept URLs from this domain. Change the allowed or blocked domains under Project settings.
This project has submitted too many websites in the last minute. Wait for the Retry-After period, or lower the pace of submissions.
You have reached this upload preset's daily upload limit. Try again after midnight UTC.
This site isn't allowed to upload through this upload preset.
This field is set by the upload preset or the upload token and can't be changed by the upload.
The upload preset changed, or was created or deleted, since you read it. Retrieve it again and retry with its current revision.
Another upload preset in this project has this key. Choose a different key.
A preset that anyone can upload to needs a daily upload limit.
The folder isn't in this project. Choose a folder from this project and try again.
The policy isn't one of this organisation's. Choose one of its policies and try again.
The project's settings or metadata fields changed since you read them. Retrieve them again and retry with the current revision.
Turning on AI media search needs a searchIndexingBudgetUnits of at least the current indexing estimate, which details.indexingUnits gives.
The project has no metadata field with this ID.
The upload token is invalid. Sign a new one on your server with an active API key for this project.
The upload token has expired. Sign a new one on your server.
The upload token has already been used. Each token uploads one asset.
Remote URLs must use HTTP or HTTPS and cannot target private networks, localhost names or URL credentials.
The URL responded with an error status. Check that it is publicly reachable.
The appeal does not exist in this project.
The judgment event is unavailable, belongs to another project or cannot supply an asset decision. Supply explicit context instead.
The linked asset does not exist in this project.
You cannot review this project's appeals.
A reviewer already resolved this appeal.
The linked asset's decision changed after the appealed decision. Submit a new appeal for the current decision.
The decision's action is not valid for this appeal.
